macros.name: WCcoordinate
macros.doc: If the key discrete is false then this command gives the coordinate positioned at ⟨name⟩ of slice ⟨number⟩.

macros.name: WCcoordinate
macros.doc: If the key discrete is false then this command gives the coordinate positioned at ⟨name⟩ of slice ⟨number⟩.

macros.name: WCcountdiscrete
macros.doc: If the key discrete is true then this macro gives the current number of the TikZ pic from the key discrete pic.

macros.name: WCdataangle
macros.doc: This macro is similar to \WCmidangle but also takes into account the keys data angle pos, data angle shift, data pos and data sep (with respect to the key counterclockwise).

macros.name: WClegend
macros.doc: If the key legend row is used then the resulting legend is stored in the macro \WClegend.

macros.name: WCmidangle
macros.doc: This macro gives the angle in degrees modulo 360 of the middle of the current slice.

macros.name: WCperc
macros.doc: This macro displays \WCpercentagerounded followed by a % symbol.

macros.name: WCpoint
macros.doc: This command gives the point where the angle is determined by \WCangle and the radius by \WCradius computed with the given arguments.

macros.name: WCpoint
macros.doc: This command gives the point where the angle is determined by \WCangle and the radius by \WCradius computed with the given arguments.

macros.name: WCradius
macros.doc: This command gives the convex combination with parameter ⟨pos⟩ of the inner radius of slice ⟨number⟩ minus ⟨sep⟩ and the outer radius of slice ⟨number⟩ plus ⟨sep⟩.

macros.name: WCradius
macros.doc: This command gives the convex combination with parameter ⟨pos⟩ of the inner radius of slice ⟨number⟩ minus ⟨sep⟩ and the outer radius of slice ⟨number⟩ plus ⟨sep⟩.

macros.name: WCtotalcount
macros.doc: This macro gives the total number of slices.
